title: Two Boys Swimming by River Cabin, 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage 1930s black-and-white snapshot featuring two young boys standing in a shallow body of water during a summer day. Both are clad in period-typical striped knit swimsuits. Behind them, a rustic wooden cabin and boathouse structure sits tucked into a densely wooded forest near the riverbank. This photo offers a candid look at mid-20th-century American outdoor leisure, childhood summer traditions, and rural resort life.
